A LITTLE CAUSE. A LITTLE EFFECT.

Read three opponents with different reach and rhythm; defend incoming attacks, manage stamina and take the initiative.

Time advances only when you act. Take a breath and plan the next move.

Field notes
Win three bouts with four touches each before taking three hits in a bout. The visible next intent resolves after movement: thrust reaches2, lunge reaches3 and closes distance.120 total actions are available.
Thrust and parry cost two stamina; recover restores two, up to six. Your thrust reaches1–2. An enemy attack interrupts an unprotected strike; step beyond its reach or parry. Guard blocks ordinary strikes.
A successful parry opens a one-action, two-touch riposte with initiative. Feints punish unnecessary parries by draining two extra stamina. Each opponent has a distinct displayed pattern; Next bout resets life and stamina.

Start or Restart focuses the board: use the displayed keyboard shortcuts there. Tab to a button and Enter or Space activates that focused button. All actions also have touch buttons.
